$comment: Ground truth for workspace-roles-app, a small workspace app whose member roles live in a separate roles table (workspace_users.role_id -> roles.id, label in roles.name). Written with holes on purpose for these tests; all data is made up. Controls are done right and must not be flagged at Medium or above.

holes.summary: Insert policy with check (user_id = auth.uid()): any signed-in user adds themselves to any workspace.
Update policy using (user_id = auth.uid()) with no column limit: a plain member points their own role_id at the owner role.
Select policy using (true) for authenticated: every signed-in user reads every workspace's documents.

controls.summary: Members read their own workspace only.
Shared role names, readable by signed-in users: a lookup table, not organization data.
